shared_elements: figures arranged in horizontal registers or bands
a radiating/rayed motif (rosette-like in A, star/burst-like in B)
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both surfaces organise their imagery in horizontal registers and both contain a rayed/radiating motif and roughly figural forms with projecting limbs. Otherwise the content differs entirely: A shows a symmetrical, densely detailed scene of large winged anthropomorphic beings flanking an elaborate stylised plant above a band of script-like signs, while B shows sparse, flat, schematic silhouetted forms with no symmetry, no attributes, no enclosing composition and nothing resembling writing.
